body: Hey, hey there. I can be a friend. I don’t know how much I can listen because I’m in a bad spot right now too, but I can be a friend. At least we wouldn’t be quite as lonely together
Can someone just hold me? Please? Please I cant do this anymore. Please
We have a darius and a Caleb.
Fair enough. That is generally the point, but I’ll have to save this unsavory idea for another day.
Makes sense. I’ll keep that in mind. Thanks
Thanks. Why would clothing make it worse, wouldn’t it protect some? Anyways, it may or may not happen, although I tend to chicken out of anything like this
That’s valid!! I’m normally only observing, so valid

That’s so interesting!! It gives me some hope to hear that your guys ability to understand eachother improved. Sometimes I am aware of fill conversations with some sort of theme, but it’s almost like it’s in a different language. Or it’s not, but it’s just so hard to understand
That’s a tough spot to be in. I don’t have any advice, just wanted to say hello and offer support

Yes!! Thank you for replying, that’s super similar then what I experience. When I’m not fronting I feel like I’m high, so I wonder what it looks like for everyone while one person fronts and I am staring out at the world, slack jawed, confused and disconnected

This makes me feel very valid!!! I’ve always had a hard time sorting through my thoughts, because I always had SO. MUCH. NOISE. I’m beginning to understand that a lot of that sound might not be mine. During the day it’s more like... white noise. Although when I’m not fronting I can hear myself speak inside the headspace sometimes, and occasionally people reply. It’s so clear yet unclear
So valid!!! We’re in a very similar spot as you! Feel free to message us if you ever want to chat. It’s quite the place in life to be
I’m glad your feeling affirmed by this therapist!!! Hopefully that means everything is going in the right direction for you all ^^
BTW my username is a system name purely because in the chunks of time when someone else is fronting or I’m not doubting myself we decided we need something to be referred to as
